lines: Adjusted Diluted EPS Increased 9%  Full Year Cash Flow from Operations of $323 Million Deployed to Invest for Growth, Strengthen Balance Sheet and Return Value to Shareholders  Company Provides Fiscal 2027 Guidance In line with Financial Algorithm PLANO, Texas, November 10, 2026 – Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 and full year (quarter and year to 30 Sep 2026)
desk.headline: Q4 sales up 0.6% to $953m, adjusted EPS $0.62 beat; fiscal 2027 EPS guided to $2.20-2.30
results: Q4 sales edged up 0.6% to $953m; comparable sales rose 0.9%, led by Sally Beauty stores (+2.0%) while salon supplier BSG slipped 0.6%.
Gross margin dipped 0.3 pts to 51.9%, but lower costs lifted the adjusted operating margin to 10.0% and adjusted EPS 13% to $0.62.
For the full year, sales grew 0.9% to $3.73bn and adjusted EPS rose 9% to $2.08 (GAAP $2.02).
Operating cash flow was $323m for the year and free cash flow $210m; Sally repaid $80m of term loan and bought back $113m of shares ($42m in Q4).
Year-end cash was $158m with nothing drawn on the revolver; net debt leverage was 1.4x and the store count fell by 32 to 4,390.

guidance.summary: Sally gave its first fiscal 2027 outlook: sales of $3.77-3.81bn on 1-2% comparable growth and adjusted EPS of $2.20-2.30, assuming half of free cash flow goes to buybacks. Q1 adjusted EPS is guided to $0.48-0.52.

watch: Whether BSG comparable sales return to growth after a weak year (-0.8%).
Q1 delivery against $945-955m sales, including about 0.3 pts of currency drag.
Pace of buybacks and debt repayment from roughly $200m of expected free cash flow.
